scope: Local design questions, saved study references and proposed trial methods.

E2.evidence: Palm 10 co-occurrence informed species choice. Holder trial compares mixed and same-species pairs and singles. No growing outcomes.

E3.units: Depth in mm, soil plan area in m², volume in L.
E3.equal_volume: soil plan area m² = soil litres / depth mm
E3.equal_reserved_area: soil plan area equals reserved bounding width × length except for circular pot which uses π/4 of square reserved area
E3.scope: Straight-sided inside soil outlines only. Source holders and their actual dimensions are linked in the library.

E5.scope: Saved pot and pad geometry and observed host relationship motivate a proposed rough mounting test.

E6.formula: rain_mm × catchment_m2 = rain_input_l; rain_input_l minus collected drainage_plus_overflow_l = input balance at cutoff
E6.scope: Roof experiment informs the collection method. Runoff and timing for this fern planter are unmeasured.

E7.scope: Geometry informs a full-size mock-up service path and log. Reach, safe access, actual kit mass and support capacity need separate checks.

E8.formula: measured_daily_supply_demand_l × trial_gap_days = volume target in L
E8.scope: Capacity alone cannot establish how quickly water will reach the mix. Measure system losses, usable water, wetness, overflow and fern health.
